signature: class OpenDartEvidenceCollector(api_key: str | None = None, *, request_json: JsonRequest | None = None, generated_time: datetime | None = None)
requirements: Add a single-worker-only monthly disclosure collector; it must not create threads, processes, async tasks, or accept a worker-count option.

Persist a versioned manifest under the output directory. It must bind requested start/end dates, page size, retry policy, source endpoint, and each month status; a conflicting range or policy fails with ValueError.

Persist every successfully fetched page atomically before requesting the next page. On resume, validate page SHA-256, request parameters, page number, and page-size before reuse; an invalid checkpoint is marked incomplete and re-fetched.

After every page and every terminal failure, atomically persist progress. A complete month is written atomically only after all expected pages are validated and the month record list is sorted and unique by receipt number.

Retry only transient transport exceptions, HTTP 408/429/5xx, and DART statuses 800 or 900. Use deterministic exponential backoff min(max_backoff_seconds, initial_backoff_seconds * 2**retry_index), with default attempts=5, initial=1 second, max=30 seconds, and a configurable minimum inter-request interval.

Treat DART status 013 for list.json as a valid empty result. Treat status 020 (quota), 010/011/012/021/100/101/901, malformed responses, invalid receipt identity, and exhausted retries as fail-closed terminal errors; do not silently create a complete month.
Use a non-blocking exclusive process lock on the output directory; a concurrent invocation fails before issuing any request. Process termination must release the lock automatically.
Merge only complete hash-validated month artifacts. The final disclosure artifact is atomically written, receipt-sorted, duplicate-free, and never replaces an existing output whose bytes differ.
All sleep, monotonic-clock, and request behavior must be injectable for deterministic tests; no real network or sleep is allowed in unit tests.

scenarios.name: test_collect_evidence_resume_and_merge_commands
scenarios.expected_behavior: Existing resumable CLI behavior remains covered while DART adds its own resume and merge commands.

planned_test_scenarios.expected_behavior: After a page-two transient failure, a second invocation reuses the hash-valid page-one checkpoint and requests only page two onward.
Transport/429/5xx/800/900 retry with injected delays; quota 020 and invalid-key errors stop without retry.
A status-013 response produces a complete, hash-valid empty month artifact.
Merge rejects a missing, incomplete, or digest-mismatched monthly artifact and leaves the final output untouched.
The resume command exposes no concurrency option and delegates to one collector call.
